chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"There is no harm in a man giving to another man on behalf of two, three, or four persons, meaning Zakat al-Fitrah."

key_terms.الْفِطْرَةَ: Zakat al-Fitrah, the alms due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to give Zakat al-Fitrah on behalf of multiple people in one payment?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding Zakat al-Fitrah. It states that there is no problem in one person giving the fitrah on behalf of multiple individuals together to another person.
